source.title: Who works where (ladder unit, machine-drafted)
source.author: Go course authors (drafted by an AI model)
source.attribution: Course-authored controlled German. Drafted by an AI model; not yet reviewed by a native speaker.
source.provenance: Drafted by an AI model for the course ladder; not reviewed by a native speaker. It is controlled, deliberately repetitive German written for learners and may contain unnatural phrasing. The English lines are the drafter's own.
source.licenseNote: Owned by the course authors; machine-drafted, not yet native-reviewed.

review.notes: Machine-drafted by an AI model; awaiting native-speaker review. Pastor Thomas uses du with Sam (a free church; first names in the Gemeinde); Sam and Herr Schmidt say Sie. "Student" is the learner of German at a language course (a "Sprachkurs" student). Occupation after sein has no article ("Er ist Bäcker"); "als" is used with arbeiten ("Ich arbeite als Lehrer"). "Chef" is used for the boss in a bakery or clinic; at a school the usual word would be "Schulleiter", which the ladder does not use yet. Michael, a doctor at Anna's clinic, is new in the cast.

english.source: drafted with the text; not reviewed

sentences.text: Alle sind in der Küche der Kirche.
sentences.english: Everyone is in the church kitchen.

sentences.text: Es gibt Kaffee, Milch und Kuchen.
sentences.english: There is coffee, milk and cake.

sentences.speaker: thomas
sentences.english: I work here as a pastor.

sentences.speaker: schmidt
sentences.english: And I am the boss too.

sentences.speaker: sam
sentences.text: Ihr Beruf ist schön, Herr Schmidt.
sentences.english: Your job is nice, Herr Schmidt.

sentences.speaker: schmidt
sentences.text: Und was machen Sie, Herr Miller?
sentences.english: And what do you do, Mr Miller?

sentences.text: Anna und Lukas kommen in die Küche.
sentences.english: Anna and Lukas come into the kitchen.

sentences.speaker: anna
sentences.text: Ich arbeite als Krankenschwester in der Klinik.
sentences.english: I work as a nurse at the clinic.

sentences.speaker: lukas
sentences.text: Ich habe eine Klasse mit zwanzig Schülern.
sentences.english: I have a class with twenty pupils.

sentences.speaker: anna
sentences.text: Du arbeitest in der Kirche, Thomas.
sentences.english: You work in the church, Thomas.

sentences.speaker: thomas
sentences.text: Ja, ein Pastor arbeitet am Sonntag.
sentences.english: Yes, a pastor works on Sunday.

sentences.speaker: lukas
sentences.english: You all work a great deal.

sentences.speaker: sam
sentences.text: Thomas ist Pastor, Anna ist Krankenschwester, Lukas ist Lehrer, und Herr Schmidt ist Bäcker.
sentences.english: Thomas is a pastor, Anna is a nurse, Lukas is a teacher, and Herr Schmidt is a baker.

sentences.speaker: sam
sentences.english: My mother is a nurse too.

sentences.speaker: anna
sentences.text: Er ist Arzt, und er ist 50 Jahre alt.
sentences.english: He is a doctor, and he is 50 years old.

sentences.speaker: sam
sentences.english: A doctor works a great deal.

sentences.speaker: sam
sentences.text: Er ist ein sehr guter Mann.
sentences.english: He is a very good man.

sentences.speaker: lukas
sentences.text: Der Mann ist auch in der Kirche.
sentences.english: The man is in the church too.

sentences.speaker: sam
sentences.english: Who is making the coffee here?

sentences.speaker: thomas
sentences.text: Sie kocht den Kaffee und den Kuchen.
sentences.english: She makes the coffee and the cake.

sentences.speaker: anna
sentences.text: Er ist bei Marta, in der Küche.
sentences.english: He is with Marta, in the kitchen.

sentences.speaker: sam
sentences.text: Herr Schmidt, wie ist Ihr Tag?
sentences.english: Herr Schmidt, what is your day like?

sentences.speaker: schmidt
sentences.text: Ich stehe um vier Uhr auf.
sentences.english: I get up at four o'clock.

sentences.speaker: schmidt
sentences.text: Ich mache den ganzen Tag Brötchen, Brot und Kuchen.
sentences.english: I make rolls, bread and cake all day.

sentences.speaker: sam
sentences.text: Und der Preis für ein Brötchen?
sentences.english: And the price for a roll?

sentences.speaker: schmidt
sentences.text: Meine Tochter arbeitet auch in der Bäckerei.
sentences.english: My daughter works in the bakery too.

sentences.speaker: sam
sentences.text: Das ist eine gute Familie, Herr Schmidt.
sentences.english: That is a good family, Herr Schmidt.

sentences.speaker: ben
sentences.text: Ich möchte ein Ei und Kartoffeln.
sentences.english: I would like an egg and potatoes.

sentences.speaker: ben
sentences.text: Meine Mama ist Chef von der Küche!
sentences.english: My mama is the boss of the kitchen!

sentences.speaker: thomas
sentences.text: Die Küche ist groß, das ist gut.
sentences.english: The kitchen is big, that is good.

sentences.speaker: thomas
sentences.english: We would like to tidy up the kitchen.

sentences.speaker: sam
sentences.text: Ich möchte heute auch mein Zimmer aufräumen.
sentences.english: I would like to tidy my room today too.

sentences.speaker: sam
sentences.text: Das Bett, der Stuhl, der Tisch, alles ist da.
sentences.english: The bed, the chair, the table, everything is there.
